mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals an emergency monetary policy response to economic distress, which typically precedes a rebound in equity markets as the central bank stabilizes financial conditions within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS drops below 0.25%, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate indicates a monetary policy response to a labor market shock, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in expected economic stabilization.
regime_hint: monetary easing during labor market deterioration
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary and fiscal policy responses that boost corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 600,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that typically precedes a 20-day rebound in equity markets as investors anticipate policy stimulus and reduced interest rate pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 600.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically triggers a market rally within 60 trading days as the central bank implements monetary stimulus to prevent a deeper recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), the market prices in a potential recession, but the subsequent policy response leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy stabilizes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
